clips.title: The story
paras: Athridas Bearmantle is a night elf sentinel residing in Dolanaar within the boughs of Teldrassil. Tasked with safeguarding the local settlement, he directs young adventurers to investigate the encroaching corruption affecting the local wildlife and the nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs.

Stationed within Dolanaar, Athridas Bearmantle stands as an early line of defense for the night elves emerging from Shadowglen. As the boughs of the newly grown world tree Teldrassil exhibit unnatural signs of decay and unrest, Athridas works tirelessly to coordinate local scouting efforts and protect the peaceful township from surrounding threats.
